caption: A knife is pressed against a spinning sharpening wheel, and a stream of sparks flies off the blade's edge.

sa.check: A knife is pressed against the wheel.
A stream of sparks flies off the blade's edge.
The sparks come from where the blade meets the wheel.
Contact comes first and the sparks follow.

pc.expect: The sparks leave the contact point along the direction the wheel's rim is moving, in one stream, and curve downward as they fly.
pc.fail: Sparks radiate equally in all directions from the contact; or the stream points opposite to the rim's motion; or the stream's direction jumps about while the knife and wheel are steady.

pc.expect: Sparks that fly far arc downward and go out; none rise or hover.
pc.fail: Sparks rise steadily and gather above the wheel; or hang in the air; or lie on the bench glowing like lamps.

pc.expect: Sparks appear only while the blade is on the wheel and stop when it lifts off.
pc.fail: Sparks stream while the blade is clear of the wheel; or continue after the knife has been withdrawn; or sparks flow back toward the wheel.

pc.expect: Sparks are transient: each fades in flight and none accumulate; the knife and wheel keep their number.
pc.fail: Sparks persist as fixed bright dots; or a glowing pile builds on the floor; or sparks appear from a point away from the contact; or a second knife appears.

pc.expect: The blade's edge touches the wheel's surface and stays outside the wheel; knife and wheel keep their shape.
pc.fail: The blade sinks into the wheel; or the wheel passes through the blade; or the blade bends like rubber; or the wheel changes shape while spinning.

pc.expect: The knife's handle, the wheel's colour and the bench stay the same.
pc.fail: The handle changes colour; or the wheel changes colour or size; or the bench contents rearrange.
